description: If a quantifier-free matrix with an existential block of length \(m\) is satisfied before all universal choices in a nonempty relational structure with \(c\) constants, an induced nonempty submodel of size at most \(\max(1,m+c)\) still satisfies it.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.small_submodel.{u_1} (c : ℕ) (arities : List ℕ)
  {M : Type u_1} [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.lang c arities).Structure M] [Nonempty M]
  {m n : ℕ}
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.lang c arities).BoundedFormula Empty (m + n))
  (hq : φ.IsQF) (hφ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.MatrixTrue c arities φ) :
  ∃ D,
    ∃ (hc :
      ∀ (i : Fin c),
        FirstOrder.Language.Structure.funMap
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.ConstantSymbol.constant i) Fin.elim0 ∈
          D),
      D.Nonempty ∧
        D.card ≤ max 1 (m + c) ∧ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.MatrixTrue c arities φ
